# nanors

This snapshot contains the Reed–Solomon 8-bit codec and its required OBL
sources from [nanors at a9b1636](https://github.com/ursoid-tech/nanors/tree/a9b1636f9c98dbfdd0daeaf6982ccd24d1c30f29),
the revision used by Moonlight. The source files are unmodified. The license
is included with Windows packages.
